title: Connotation and Denotation
skills: distinguish denotative meaning from connotative meaning
analyze how connotation influences tone and audience response
compare neutral and emotionally charged word choices
apply precise word choice in analytical and persuasive writing
alignment_note: Explains the difference between denotation, a word's literal meaning, and connotation, the associations or emotional meanings attached to it. Supports vocabulary development, rhetorical analysis, tone analysis, precise diction, and intentional word choice across high school English courses.
